ModMetaData.name: Wil's Role Modules : Military
ModMetaData.author: Spaceman_Wil
ModMetaData.description: Recruit, then Soldier or Ranger, then a specialty with its own job on the battlefield: Vanguard, Guardian and Duelist for the line; Marksman, Gunner and Sniper for the guns. Experience comes from fighting real hostile enemies. Each specialty changes how its holder fights (when it is assigned and the situation calls for it) and which target a shooter prefers; none of it forces a pawn to move. Early draft: offline builds and tests do not constitute RimWorld gameplay validation.
